newsitem.title: USA: ICG to lease fiber optic capacity.
newsitem.headline: ICG to lease fiber optic capacity.

text.p: ICG Communications Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to lease 105 miles of fiber optic capacity from the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power for 15 years.
The agreement allows ICG, a provider of local exchange telephone services, to use facilities throughout downtown Los Angeles, Century City, West Los Angeles, Mid-Wilshire, and Sherman Oaks.
Financial terms of the lease were not disclosed.

ICG said it has identified about 530 office buildings, each containing more than 50,000 square feet, in the network service area, which encompasses more than 3.5 million people and more than 200 million square feet of office space.
